decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 (E595-06) and LH-02 (C512-04) are down. The repair estimates are 3-5 h and 4-6 h, so both stopes lose most of the rest of the shift. No confirmation is needed under CONFIRM-01. No reserve can be activated, because no stope is stopped and RESERVE-01 forbids taking a loader from a producing place. LH-10 is idle at TALLER-564 and is free to move, so I send it to E595-06 (15.4 g/t, 0.495 oz/t, 256 t of broken ore left, 80 m from the stockpile). It finishes preventive maintenance at 11:00. Travel is about 0.45 h, so it starts mucking at about 11:30 as loading resumes. An LH410 at 80 m moves about 30.9 t/h. Over about 5.5 h that is about 170 t, or about 84 oz, at no development cost. For C512-04 (13 g/t, 0.418 oz/t, 314 t left, 220 m), I lend LH-08 from DS-C512-01, which is on the same level, so travel is short. At 220 m an LH410 moves about 25.4 t/h. Over about 6.75 h of loading that is about 170 t, or about 71 oz. The development heading is worth 1.9 oz/h, so about 7.5 h away costs about 14 oz, for a net of about 57 oz. I leave LH-09 on DS-E543-02. It is a critical-path heading worth 4 oz/h, and a second loader on E595-06 would add little because LH-10 already covers most of the ore left there. Both stockpiles (Este 171 t, Central 264 t, capacity 450 t each) and the trucks have headroom, so nothing is capped. Total is about 84 + 57, or roughly 140 oz.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
